name: Bridge USDB
who_can_redeem: Bridge documentation states direct purchasers of Bridge Stablecoins must be associated with a KYC'd Bridge customer; USDB can be converted through Bridge orchestration into fiat or other supported stablecoins.
redemption_region_notes: Bridge Stablecoins are not available to EEA end users and direct purchasers must satisfy Bridge KYC and compliance requirements.
redemption_notes: USDB can be exchanged to and from fiat or supported stablecoins through Bridge orchestration. This record does not infer unrestricted public redemption outside Bridge-approved customer flows.
summary: Bridge-native USD stablecoin backed 1:1 by U.S.-dollar reserve assets and used across Bridge treasury, wallet and orchestration products.
notes: Canonical name is namespaced as Bridge USDB to distinguish this asset from Blast USDB, while the USDB symbol and alias are preserved. Bridge's May 7, 2025 announcement documents the product live and in use. Current Bridge documentation supports USDB on Base and Solana; exact current contract addresses are not asserted from example API payloads.
